description: This source file provides utility functions for version string processing, including converting version strings to number arrays, comparing version tags, and retrieving sorted version tags from a directory.

methods.name: to_number
methods.description: Converts a version string like '1.2.3' into an array of numbers [1, 2, 3].

methods.name: compare_version_tags
methods.description: Compares two version strings numerically; returns true if v1 is less than v2.

methods.name: get_version_tags
methods.description: Retrieves and sorts version tags from a directory, filtering directories matching 'vX.X.X' pattern.
